title: Is there a slop meter you guys are following? Intro example
author: GeorgiaWitness1
selftext:
So i did this intro for my game. Looks amazing with Opus 5.5 blessing. But is there a metric for slop we should follow? 

noticeable ? An workflow to spot for "Slop Vibes" is required ? 

This is a Brave new world, no clue about standards now.

comments.author: hugomcjohnson
comments.body: Did you give it images to work with? Or how did it make the video?

replies.author: GeorgiaWitness1
replies.body:
yes. I have a all workflow that uses Gemini and GPT 2.5 to keep the style consistent and avoid the "piss filter" as much as possible.

The rest is just layers and animations based on the original image.

replies.author: hugomcjohnson
replies.body:
Amazing, can you say more about how you made the layers and animations? 

Also how long did this take?

replies.author: GeorgiaWitness1
replies.body: Atlantis dwarf slop edition you mean lol

replies.body: BTW it was a fun video just reminds me of the mines of moria.

replies.author: GeorgiaWitness1
replies.body:
Is just the idea placeholder.

comments.author: Cosmonan
comments.body:
This is looking pretty solid, but I can still see people calling it slop just for the yellow hue (as you described: piss filter) from the beginning. I would use less yellow lighting in the early scenes just so it won't cause an impression from the start. 

The style itselft is pretty consistent, I would just add more colder colors.

replies.author: GeorgiaWitness1

The human face of the commander is out of place and the narration is too slow... going almost nowhere. You could say: "we went in the mines, we awoken something there". Everything else is fluff, you can probably be more direct.  
Also the tile is Blackvein Descent when I'm not sure you used that anytime before, Blackvein comes out of the blue.

replies.body:
yah for sure. 

Classical thing like everything looks fine, but one by one looks stupid

comments.author: orellanaed
comments.body: There's no number for it but every complaint here is the same tell which is pieces that don't agree with each other like the commander's face or a title the narration never sets up. I'd check each shot against the one before it and cut what only shows up once.

comments.body: I didn't notice any real "Slop" It is more so the complete lack of originality to the whole thing. It does look amazing but has no identity of its own.

replies.author: GeorgiaWitness1
replies.body:
yah ofc. The story is also pure garbage slop. 

Talking more about the animation and so on.

comments.author: feralferrous
comments.body: For me, it's always the lack of animation that tends to stick out, like that dwarf that slightly tilts while blowing the horn.

comments.author: AltruisticPossible84
comments.body: The captions look too sanitized, much like a lot of Opus 5.5 output. If you're concerned with noticeable AI influence, I'd perhaps look into stylized caption blocks, or at least remove the current grey squares and figure out a different solution to readability

comments.author: RelationshipIll9576
comments.body:
It reads as slop for a few reasons. 

The narrator text is awful. It's all one big cliche that has been heard again and again. And the made up down names and meandering story is exactly what AI produces. 

The voice over sounds heavily like AI. It's too stereotypical and offers no real personality other than it being *serious.* It comes across as what a 12 year old would think is cool but not a game designer that really knows what they are doing.

The music reads as AI as well. A small indie team isn't going to be able to afford music made by a full orchestra. And if they have a game audio composer/musician, they aren't going to do stuff that's incredibly predictable unless they are very low skill. 

The art is all over the place. It looks like it's done by a bunch of different artists, which is a good sign that AI generated it. AI can't do consistency well in general, and it really shows in the visuals.

The lack of actual game play and hyper focus on the story only makes it look like it's built by someone that doesn't know how to design games. Another sign that it's AI-driven. But it doesn't just come across as AI-driven. It comes across as AI-designed, which is just weak, boring, predictable, and absolutely reads as slop. 

If someone can ask themselves "have I seen this before?" and there is nothing to really point to that says "yes", then it will read like AI.
